title: Blind Spots Travel, Knowledge Stays Home: What RL Inherits from an LLM Judge
abstract: arXiv:2611.25191v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM judges serve as rewards where no answer key exists, in the hope that their knowledge passes to the trained model. In 814 RL runs that teach 7-8B models to answer closed-book questions or abstain, we ask what passes. What a grader knows about single answers stays home. A wrong answer that a judge rewards is memorised for that one question. A model trained with the answer key, or with a far stronger judge, chooses which new questions to answer no better than the untrained model does by sampling 32 answers and abstaining where they disagree; the grader's knowledge adds about one corrected answer per hundred questions. What a grader believes about a kind of question travels. A judge that rejects eleven of the twelve correct training answers about capitals of former states teaches the model to refuse 98% of such capitals on new questions, a loss that accuracy and abstention rates do not reveal. translated_title: 盲区会迁移，知识留原地：强化学习从大模型评审员那里继承了什么
translated_abstract: 大模型评审员在不存在标准答案的场景中充当奖励信号，人们期望其知识能够传递给被训练的模型。在814次强化学习运行中，我们训练7-8B参数的模型回答闭卷问题或选择弃答，并探究究竟什么能够被传递。评审员对单个答案的了解会留在原地：一个被评审员奖励的错误答案只会在那一个问题上被记住。使用标准答案或远强评审员训练出的模型，在选择回答哪些新问题方面，并不比未训练模型通过采样32个答案并在答案不一致时弃答的策略更好；评审员的知识大约每百个问题只带来一个被纠正的答案。而评审员对某一类问题的看法则会迁移：一个拒绝了12个关于“已消失国家首都”正确训练答案中11个的评审员，会使模型在新问题上拒绝98%的此类首都问题，而这种损失无法从准确率和弃答率中显现。仅通过手工修改这12个判定……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 通过814次强化学习实验，本文发现LLM评审员对单个答案的知识几乎不会传递给被训练的模型（每百题仅纠正约一题），但其对某类问题的“盲区”会迁移，导致模型在新问题上系统性地拒绝回答该类问题。
en_tdlr: Across 814 RL runs, this paper shows that an LLM judge's knowledge of individual answers barely transfers to the trained model (adding only about one corrected answer per hundred questions), while its blind spots about a category of questions do travel, causing the model to systematically refuse that category on new questions.
